ARXML reference path concatenation order incorrect

When loading ARXML files with relative references, the reference base path and relative path are concatenated in the wrong order, causing dangling reference errors.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
import cantools

# This should work but fails with dangling reference error
db = cantools.db.load_file('tests/files/arxml/system-4.2.arxml')
```

The error occurs when trying to resolve relative ARXML references. The system concatenates the reference base path and relative path as `{arxml_path}/{refbase_path}` instead of the correct order `{refbase_path}/{arxml_path}`.

This affects loading of ARXML files that contain relative references with reference bases, resulting in "Encountered dangling reference" errors for otherwise valid ARXML files.
</issue>
